3.4 Adapting the material for local use
To ensure maximum outreach and resonance, each
member state will have to adapt the template
materials to their particular audiences. This may
include:
• Translating materials
• Evaluating materials currently in use in the
member state to discern the applicability/
relevance of the toolkit materials, for example to
avoid duplication
• Presenting/testing template materials with
contacts in each member state prior to wider
dissemination to ensure that the messages/
visuals speak to the national audience
